metadata.case_name: CHAN WAI LUN ROBIN v. KAI SHING MANAGEMENT SERVICES LTD AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: Ran his own transportation business; removed and delivered goods (owner/operator of a light goods vehicle)

injuries.description: 100% cut of the ulnar artery, nerve, flexor digitorum superficialis to the little finger and flexor carpi ulnaris as well as the dorsal sensory branch of the ulnar nerve.
source: injuries to his right wrist caused by broken glass. There was a 100% cut of the ulnar artery, nerve and other injuries as set out in the medical reports.
the plaintiff had a 100% cut of the ulnar artery, nerve, flexor digitorum superficialis to the little finger and flexor carpi ulnaris as well as the dorsal sensory branch of the ulnar nerve.
